[INJSO 2015 — question paper]
40. Origin of life in earth is traced back to about 3 billion years ago. Oparin (1924), and
John Haldane (1929), independently suggested that if, the primitive atmosphere was
reducing (as opposed to oxygen-rich), and if there was an appropriate supply of energy,
such as lightning or ultraviolet light, then a wide range of organic compounds might be
synthesized. Their hypothesis was proven by the famous Miller and Urey experiment.
Using high voltage electric sparks they could experimentally generate bio-molecules
from elemental gases.
These experiments helped us to understand the sequence of events that might have
helped in origin of life in earth.
